The '''Skirmsh on Dandelo''' was a conflict on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dandelo]] between a tribe of [[Fuzzum]]s and their allies on one side and the [[Starhunter's Intergalactic Menagerie|Starhunters]] and their [[Sentry droid/Legends|patrol droids]] on the other. The fight took place at a complex of cave dwellings that had formerly been inhabited by the Fuzzums but which the Starhunters were using as cages for the beasts they used aboard their [[Starhunter's Intergalactic Menagerie]]. While the Fuzzums attacked a patrol droid with their [[Spear/Legends|spears]] on the ground level, the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], the [[Tammuz-an (species)/Legends|Tammuz-an]] prince [[Coby]], and the old [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] [[Greej]] attacked another patrol droid on a higher level of caves. The Fuzzums and their allies managed to incapacitate the droids, and the skirmish was thought to be over. However, the Starhunters arrived on the scene and tussled with Greej and the others over the only [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] present. When they secured the weapon, they began to make their escape. The timely arrival of a [[Miner/Legends|miner]] named [[Jann Tosh]] stopped them in their tracks and won the day for the Fuzzums. As a result of the battle, the Starhunters were arrested, their animals came under the care of Greej and Coby, and the Fuzzums reclaimed their former homes.<ref name="CATS" />
